$comment: Wire contract for callable `calculateDeliveryQuote`, consumed by the Kotlin Multiplatform client. Validated by functions/tests/unit/contract.test.ts, which drives the real handler and compares its JSON output against this file. Change the handler and this test fails — update both together, then update the Kotlin models.

transport.moneyUnit: integer minor units (kobo). Never send or expect a decimal.
transport.instantFormat: ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds and a trailing Z, e.g. 2026-10-14T09:00:00.000Z
transport.dateKeyFormat: YYYY-MM-DD in the company's time zone
transport.unknownRequestFields: ignored by the server (never trusted), so old clients keep working

errorShape.message: string, safe to show the user

details.detail: string, stable machine code e.g. quote.invalid_input
details.meta: object|null, field errors or extra context

request.additionalCosts: array<{ id: string, label: string, amountMinor: int, kind: enum:delivery|operating }>
request.riderCostOverride: nullable<{ amountMinor: int, reason: string, note: nullable<string> }>
request.customerPriceOverride: nullable<{ amountMinor: int, reason: string, allowBelowMinimum: nullable<bool> }>

quote.lines: array<{ code: string, label: string, amountMinor: int, note: nullable<string> }>
quote.distance: nullable<{ metres: int, source: enum:provider|manual|zone_based|band_estimate, provider: string, summary: nullable<string>, durationSeconds: nullable<int>, calculatedAt: instant, pickupCoordinates: nullable<{ latitude: number, longitude: number }>, destinationCoordinates: nullable<{ latitude: number, longitude: number }> }>
quote.rounding: nullable<{ incrementMinor: int, beforeMinor: int, afterMinor: int }>
quote.estimatedRiderCost: { amountMinor: int, method: enum:fixed|per_delivery|per_km|percentage_of_charge|zone_based|manual, confidence: enum:confirmed|estimated|unconfirmed, note: nullable<string> }
quote.targetProfit: { kind: enum:amount|margin|none, value: int, satisfied: bool, shortfallMinor: int }

pricingSnapshot.distanceBands: array<{ minMetres: int, maxMetres: nullable<int>, chargeMinor: int }>
pricingSnapshot.zoneRules: array<{ fromZoneId: string, toZoneId: string, chargeMinor: int }>
pricingSnapshot.surcharges: array<{ code: string, label: string, kind: enum:flat|percentage|per_km, value: int, appliesTo: enum:customer_charge|rider_cost, serviceLevels: array<string>, minDistanceMetres: nullable<int>, maxDistanceMetres: nullable<int> }>
